name: Atrem S.A.
summary: Atrem S.A. operates as a prominent general contractor for various investment projects and a crucial subcontractor for leading construction firms across Poland. The company specializes in delivering comprehensive solutions for the gas and liquid fuels sector, encompassing automation, visualization, and sophisticated control systems for exploitation, transmission, and distribution processes. Its offerings extend to implementing low-power installations, advanced measurement and control equipment, and broader automation initiatives. Atrem also designs and deploys IT systems, including proprietary solutions like the Telexus telemetry system and the Ewista passporting system, alongside developing process visualization and management platforms. Beyond these, the company provides a wide array of technological services such as electronic protection systems, building management systems (BMS), telecommunication infrastructure, ICT solutions, integrated visualization applications, and specialized custom developments. A significant area of expertise lies in cathodic protection, where Atrem offers monitoring services, polarization equipment, installation and maintenance, corrosion risk assessment and analysis, dedicated software products, and operational training for monitoring systems. Furthermore, Atrem is active in the aviation industry, handling the delivery, installation, implementation, and ongoing operation of IT, electronic, and automation systems specific to this sector. They also supply specialized industrial devices, including cathodic protection feeders, telemetric modems, boiler control units for gas pressure reduction stations, industrial port multiplexers, and TelCorr devices. Their capabilities also span renewable energy projects, involving the design, construction, consulting, and execution of wind farms, photovoltaic (solar) systems, and cogeneration facilities. Established in 1999 and headquartered in Suchy Las, Poland, Atrem S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Grupa Kapitalowa IMMOBILE S.A.
